description: Synthetic data recovery experiment for parameter identifiability. 6 known parameter vectors on the suspected dose_adj × alpha_c ridge. Run sim with known params, then fit Stan to check recovery.

parameter_vectors.note: Calibrated dose but different alpha — should be distinguishable

post_processing.step_1: Aggregate per-vector: compute outbreak rate, mean AR, by platform
post_processing.step_2: Fit Stan hurdle model to each synthetic dataset (6 fits × 4 chains)
post_processing.step_3: Compare posterior mode to true parameters
post_processing.step_4: Report: which parameters are recovered, which show ridges
post_processing.step_5: Plot joint posterior contours for dose_adj × alpha_c
